permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Used to look up the weather forecast for where you are. A single location fix is taken in the background; your coordinates are never shown on screen.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Downloads the weather forecast for your location from Open-Meteo, the on-device speech recognition model used for voice commands (downloaded once, then cached on the device), and, only if you add your own Gemini API key, sends your questions to Google's Gemini API - from Jarvis, when it does not recognise something as a command, and from Gemini, for every message.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short clip from the glasses microphone when you long-press to speak to Jarvis or Gemini, so what you say can be recognised. Recording stops as soon as a result is ready; nothing is recorded otherwise.
